lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hey Lisa, is the printer on the third floor still not working? I tried to print the contract twice and nothing came out.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yeah, it's been down since yesterday afternoon. I already put in a ticket with IT, but they said it might take until tomorrow to fix.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Tomorrow? I need three copies of this contract before my two o'clock meeting with the client.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: You could use the printer on the fifth floor for now. It's a bit slower, but it works fine.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Good idea. Could you forward me the ticket number too, just in case someone asks about it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Sure, I'll send it over now. Just so you know, that printer only has color cartridges loaded, so black-and-white pages come out a little gray.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That's okay as long as it's readable. Thanks for the heads-up.

questions.question_en: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: A broken printer on the third floor
A new contract with a client
questions.explanation_zh: 對話一開始男士就詢問三樓印表機是否還沒修好，兩人接著討論解決方法，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: When did the printer stop working?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說印表機從昨天下午就故障了，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the man most likely do next?
options: Wait until IT fixes the printer
Print his documents on the fifth floor
Ask a colleague to print for him
questions.explanation_zh: 女士建議他先用五樓的印表機，男士也表示可以接受，所以答案是 (C)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi Tom, are you free for the marketing review at ten tomorrow? I need your input on the ad budget.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Actually, I have a call with the Taipei office at that time. Could we push it back to eleven instead?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Let me check the room schedule... Room B is open from eleven to twelve, so that should work.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Great. Should I bring printouts of the Q4 campaign proposal, or will you send them digitally?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Just bring your laptop. I'll share the file through the shared drive this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sounds good. I'll also invite Rachel, since she's handling the social media portion.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Perfect, that'll save us a follow-up meeting later.

questions.question_en: What are the speakers mainly trying to do?
options: Book a conference room for a client
questions.explanation_zh: 男士因故無法在十點開會，兩人討論改到十一點，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why can't Tom attend the meeting at ten?
options: He has a call with the Taipei office
He is out of the office
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說他十點要跟台北辦公室通話，所以答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely do this afternoon?
options: Share a file through the shared drive
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說她下午會透過共用雲端硬碟分享檔案，所以答案是 (C)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Excuse me, is flight 205 to Chicago still on time? The board just says delayed, but there's no new time listed.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Let me check... I'm sorry, sir, it's now delayed about two hours because of a mechanical issue with the aircraft.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Two hours? I have a connecting flight out of Chicago at six. Will I still make it?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It'll be tight, but you might. If you end up missing it, we can rebook you on the next available flight at no extra charge.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I appreciate that. Is there somewhere nearby with Wi-Fi? I still have some work to finish.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: The lounge near gate twelve has free Wi-Fi and plenty of seating. Boarding announcements will reach you there too.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Thanks for your help.

questions.question_en: Why has the flight been delayed?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說是因為飛機發生機械故障，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the airline do if the man misses his connecting flight?
options: Rebook him at no extra charge
Put him on a waiting list
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說若錯過轉機班機，可以免費幫他改到下一班，所以答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Where will the man most likely go while he waits?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士建議他去十二號登機門附近的貴賓室，那裡有免費無線網路，所以答案是 (A)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I have a reservation for two nights under the name Johnson, starting tonight.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Let me pull that up... I see the reservation, but it looks like the room type was changed to a standard room instead of the deluxe suite you booked online.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That's strange. I definitely paid for the deluxe suite with the city view.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I apologize for the mix-up. We do have a deluxe suite available on the tenth floor, and I can upgrade you at no extra cost for the inconvenience.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That would be great, thank you. Does it still include breakfast?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, breakfast is included for both nights, served in the lobby restaurant from seven to ten a.m.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Perfect. I'll just need a couple of key cards, then.

questions.question_en: What problem does the woman have?
options: She was given the wrong room type
questions.explanation_zh: 她預訂的是豪華套房，卻被改成標準房，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does the man do to fix the problem?
options: He gives her a partial refund
He offers a free upgrade to a deluxe suite
He offers a discount on breakfast
questions.explanation_zh: 男士提出免費將她升等到十樓的豪華套房，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What time does breakfast end?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說早餐供應到早上十點，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I'd like to return this jacket. I bought it last week, but it's too small.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: No problem. Do you have the receipt with you?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, right here. I paid by credit card.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Great. Since it's within thirty days and the tags are still attached, I can give you a full refund, or you could exchange it for a larger size.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Do you have it in a medium? I think that would fit better than the small.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Let me check the stockroom... yes, we have one medium left in that color.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I'll exchange it then, thanks.

questions.question_en: What is the woman trying to do?
options: Exchange a jacket for a different size
File a complaint about a product
questions.explanation_zh: 女士表示夾克太小，想換一件較大尺寸的，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What condition allows the man to offer a refund or exchange?
options: The item must still have its tags and be within 30 days
The item must be completely unworn
The customer must have a membership card
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說只要在三十天內且吊牌還在，就能退換貨，所以答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely receive?
options: A refund to her credit card
questions.explanation_zh: 她最後選擇換成中號，所以答案是 (C)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Have you noticed the app crashing every time someone tries to upload a photo larger than five megabytes?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, I saw a few user complaints about that this morning. I think it's related to the update we pushed last night.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That would make sense — the image compression module was rewritten in that update. Should we roll it back?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I'd rather not roll back the whole update, since it also fixed the login bug. Let's just patch the compression module separately.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Okay, how long do you think that'll take?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: If I start now, I should have a fix ready to test by this evening, and we can push it out tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Great, I'll let customer support know so they can update the users who complained.

questions.question_en: What problem are the speakers discussing?
options: The app crashes when uploading large photos
questions.explanation_zh: 男士一開始就提到上傳超過五MB的照片會讓程式當機，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why doesn't the woman want to roll back the entire update?
options: It also fixed the login bug
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說那次更新也修好了登入的問題，所以不想整個復原，答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the man most likely do next?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說他會通知客服人員，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: This is the warehouse calling about order 4521. The shipment from our supplier in Vietnam is stuck at customs.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Stuck at customs? We were supposed to have those parts on the assembly line by Thursday.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I know. I've already contacted the customs broker, and they said the paperwork was missing a certificate of origin.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Can that be resolved quickly, or should we look into expediting a partial shipment by air?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: The broker thinks it can clear within two days once we resubmit the certificate, so air freight might not be necessary yet.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Alright, let's hold off on air freight for now, but keep me updated every few hours.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Will do. I'll call again as soon as I hear back from customs.

questions.question_en: Why is the shipment delayed?
options: The supplier ran out of parts
It is stuck at customs due to missing paperwork
questions.explanation_zh: 貨物卡在海關，是因為缺少產地證明，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What alternative does the man consider?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士提出是否要用空運加急部分貨物，所以答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely do next?
options: Contact customs again once she hears back
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說她一有海關的消息就會再打電話通知，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Thanks for coming in, David. I see you spent four years at Grantline Marketing. What made you decide to leave?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: The company was acquired last year, and my whole department was restructured. I'm looking for a role with more room to grow into a team lead position.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That's helpful context. This position includes managing two junior associates within the first year. How do you feel about mentoring less experienced staff?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I actually mentored two interns at my last job, and one of them was hired full-time partly based on my recommendation.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Good to know. One more thing — this role requires occasional travel to our regional offices, about once a month. Is that workable for you?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Yes, that's not a problem at all.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this conversation?
questions.explanation_zh: 這是應徵者與面試官之間的對話，屬於求職面試，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why did the man leave his previous job?
options: His company was acquired and his department restructured
He relocated to a new city
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說他的公司被收購，部門也重組了，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about the man from the conversation?
options: He has experience mentoring junior staff
He was previously a team lead
questions.explanation_zh: 男士提到自己曾指導過兩名實習生，顯示他有帶人經驗，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hi, I'd like to schedule a check-up with Dr. Reyes sometime next week if possible.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Let me see... Dr. Reyes is fully booked until Wednesday, but she has an opening at three p.m. that day.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Wednesday afternoon works for me. Actually, I also need to renew a prescription — can that be handled during the same visit?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, just mention it when you arrive, and she can review your prescription during the appointment.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Great. Do I need to bring anything specific, like previous test results?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: If you had blood work done elsewhere in the past year, it would help to bring those results, but it's not required.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Okay, I'll dig those up just in case. Thanks for your help.

questions.question_en: Why is the man calling?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士打電話是為了預約下週的健康檢查，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: When is the man's appointment?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說Reyes醫師週三下午三點有空，所以答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will the man most likely bring to the appointment?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士建議他帶去年做過的抽血報告，男士也說會去找，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hey Mark, we're almost out of printer paper and toner in the supply closet. Could you place an order today?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sure, I'll take care of it. Do we still use the same vendor, Office Direct?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Yes, but check if they have the eco-friendly paper in stock this time. The last order got substituted with the regular kind.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Got it, I'll double-check before confirming the order. Anything else we need?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Actually, yes. We're also low on the blue folders for client presentations.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I'll add those to the order. Everything should be delivered by Friday.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Perfect, that's before the client visit next Monday.

questions.question_en: What is the woman asking the man to do?
options: Place an order for office supplies
questions.explanation_zh: 女士請Mark去訂購紙張和碳粉等辦公用品，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What happened with the previous order?
options: The eco-friendly paper was substituted with regular paper
questions.explanation_zh: 女士提到上次訂的環保紙被換成一般紙張，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why does the delivery timing matter to the woman?
options: She is leaving on a trip Friday
There is a client visit next Monday
The vendor is raising prices soon
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說週五前送到才能趕上下週一的客戶來訪，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hi both, thanks for joining. I think we're still waiting on Karen from the Seoul office to connect.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I just got a message from her — she's having trouble with the video link, so she'll join by phone instead.

lines.speaker: Man 2
lines.text: That's fine. We can still share the slides on screen for her benefit; I'll read out anything that's only visual.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Good idea. Let's give her two more minutes before we start the agenda.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: In the meantime, should we confirm the numbers for the Q3 report? I noticed a discrepancy in the shipping costs section.

lines.speaker: Man 2
lines.text: I saw that too. I think it's just a formatting error, not an actual calculation mistake. I'll fix it before we present.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Perfect. Let's start with introductions once Karen's on the line.

questions.question_en: Why hasn't the meeting started yet?
options: Karen is having trouble joining by video
questions.explanation_zh: Karen因視訊連線出問題，大家在等她改用電話加入，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will Man 2 do for Karen's benefit?
options: Read aloud anything only shown on the slides
questions.explanation_zh: Man2表示會把螢幕上顯示的內容念出來給只用電話的Karen聽，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will Man 2 most likely do before the presentation?
options: Fix a formatting error in the shipping costs section
Ask Karen to review the numbers
questions.explanation_zh: Man2說他會在報告前修正運費部分的格式錯誤，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I have a reservation for a compact car under Martinez, picking up today.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Let me check... I see your reservation, but unfortunately all our compact cars are currently rented out.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Oh no, I really need something fuel-efficient since I'll be driving about 300 miles this week.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I understand. I can offer you a free upgrade to a midsize sedan at the same price — it still gets good mileage, around 35 miles per gallon.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That works for me. Does it come with GPS, or do I need to add that separately?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: GPS comes standard on that model, so you won't need to pay extra.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Great, that saves me some hassle. I'll take it.

questions.question_en: What problem does the woman face?
options: The car she reserved is unavailable
questions.explanation_zh: 她預訂的小型車目前都被租出去了，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What solution does the man offer?
options: A free upgrade to a midsize sedan
A discount on a compact car next time
questions.explanation_zh: 男士提供免費升等到中型房車，價格不變，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why is the woman pleased about the GPS?
options: It comes at no extra charge
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說GPS是該車型標配，不需額外付費，女士因此感到省事，所以答案是 (A)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hi, I have a reservation for four people at seven tonight under the name Chen, but we might need to push it back.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: No problem, what time were you thinking?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Could we move it to eight-thirty? One of our guests is arriving late from the airport.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Let me check... eight-thirty is available, but I should mention the kitchen stops taking orders for the tasting menu at nine-thirty.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That should be fine, we don't plan to stay too late anyway. Also, one of our guests has a shellfish allergy — can the kitchen accommodate that?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Absolutely, just let your server know when you arrive, and the chef will prepare an alternative dish.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Perfect, thank you for your help.

questions.question_en: What is the man trying to do?
options: Book a table for eight people
questions.explanation_zh: 男士想把訂位時間從七點延後到八點半，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why does the man want to change the time?
options: A guest is arriving late from the airport
He is running late from work
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說有一位客人的班機延誤，會晚點到，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the man most likely do when he arrives at the restaurant?
options: Tell the server about the shellfish allergy
questions.explanation_zh: 女士請他到場後告知服務生過敏資訊，男士也答應了，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I'm looking for a laptop mainly for video editing. This one in the display case caught my eye, but I'm not sure it's powerful enough.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That model has a decent processor, but for video editing, I'd actually recommend this one instead — it has a dedicated graphics card, which makes a big difference for rendering.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: What's the price difference between the two?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: This one is about two hundred dollars more, but it comes with double the storage and a two-year warranty included.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That's actually a good deal. Do you have it in silver? The one on display is black.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Let me check in the back... yes, we have two silver ones in stock.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I'll take one then, thank you.

questions.question_en: What is the woman shopping for?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士表示自己要找一台適合剪輯影片的筆記型電腦，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why does the man recommend the other model?
options: It has a dedicated graphics card for rendering
It has a longer battery life
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說那台配有獨立顯卡，對算圖有很大幫助，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely buy?
options: A black laptop with basic specs
A silver laptop with the recommended specs
A laptop with only the display model's specs
questions.explanation_zh: 女士決定買銀色、配備顯卡的那款，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hi, I'm calling about upgrading my phone plan. I keep running out of data before the month ends.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I can help with that. Right now you're on the five-gigabyte plan. Would you like me to look at the ten-gigabyte plan or the unlimited plan?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: What's the price difference between those two?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: The ten-gigabyte plan is ten dollars more per month, and the unlimited plan is twenty-five dollars more, but it includes hotspot data as well.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I don't really use hotspot much, so the ten-gigabyte plan should be enough. How soon would the change take effect?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It'll apply starting your next billing cycle, which begins in five days.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That works. Please go ahead and make that change.

questions.question_en: Why is the man calling?
options: To ask about a new phone
questions.explanation_zh: 男士因為常常用完數據流量，想要升級方案，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does the unlimited plan include that the man doesn't need?
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說無限方案多了熱點分享功能，但男士說自己不常用，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Which plan will the man most likely choose?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士表示十GB的方案就夠用了，並要求女士做更改，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I just finished the inventory count for aisle twelve, and we're showing forty units of the blue widgets, but the system says we should have sixty-five.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That's a big gap. Did you check if any were moved to the overflow section last week?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I didn't think to check there. Let me go look now.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: While you do that, I'll pull up the shipping records to see if an order went out that wasn't logged properly.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Good idea. I found twenty units in the overflow section, so that narrows the gap to just five units.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That's more reasonable — probably just a counting error somewhere. I'll note it in today's report, and we'll recount next week.

questions.question_en: What problem are the speakers addressing?
questions.explanation_zh: 兩人在討論藍色小零件的庫存數字與系統不符的問題，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Where did the man find some of the missing units?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士在溢放區找到二十個，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely do?
options: Note the discrepancy and schedule a recount
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說她會把差異記錄在報告裡，並安排下週重新清點，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Hi, I have some questions about the new health insurance options during open enrollment.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Sure, what would you like to know?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I currently have the basic plan, but I'm thinking about switching to the premium plan since my daughter will need braces this year.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: The premium plan covers orthodontic work at fifty percent, whereas the basic plan doesn't cover it at all. The premium plan does cost about sixty dollars more per month, though.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: That seems worth it given the cost of braces. When would the change take effect if I switch now?

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: If you submit the enrollment form by Friday, it'll take effect on the first of next month.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Great, I'll fill that out today then.

questions.question_en: Why is the woman considering switching plans?
options: Her current plan is being discontinued
questions.explanation_zh: 女士因為女兒今年需要戴牙套，考慮換成有理賠矯正費用的方案，所以答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How much more does the premium plan cost per month?
questions.explanation_zh: 男士說保費方案每月多六十美元，所以答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will the woman most likely do next?
options: Wait until next year to decide
Ask for a refund on her current plan
Schedule an appointment with the dentist
questions.explanation_zh: 女士說她今天就會填寫加保表格，所以答案是 (B)。

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hi, I'd like to cancel my gym membership. I'm relocating to another city next month.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I can process the cancellation, but I should mention you're still within your annual contract, so there may be an early termination fee.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: How much would that be?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: It's typically one month's fee, but if you can provide proof of relocation, like a new lease, we can waive that fee.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I do have my new lease agreement with me, actually.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Perfect. If you email that to our membership office, we'll waive the fee and process your cancellation right away.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: I'll send that over as soon as I get home.

questions.question_en: Why does the man want to cancel his membership?
options: He is unhappy with the gym
He is relocating to another city
He can no longer afford it

questions.question_en: How can the man avoid paying the termination fee?
options: By canceling six months in advance

options: Visit the gym in person tomorrow
Email his lease agreement to the membership office

lines.text: Just that they're sensitive about the timeline, so keep them updated even if there's no major news.

Follow up with the client's legal contact and send updates
Renegotiate the budget with the client

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Let's go over the marketing budget for next quarter. Right now we're proposing a ten percent increase, mostly for digital ads.

lines.text: I'm a little concerned about that increase given how tight the overall budget is this year. Can we justify it with results from this quarter?

lines.text: That's a strong argument. Do we have exact numbers I could bring to the finance committee?

lines.text: Great, let's plan to present this to the committee on Thursday, then.

Print ads are too expensive to continue
